outcome: ExHarness exposes verification and run-status as MCP tools over stdio so a supervised CLI agent can query independent verification during its own loop, while promotion remains ExHarness-owned and is never an MCP tool.
currentProblem: BB-097 deferred in-tool MCP and lifecycle hooks until supervision value is measured. Executed productization probe: agent-tools contains no MCP server. Executed BB-097 CLI probe: Codex and Kiro expose mcp add/list. Outer supervision remains the only verification path, and the agent cannot ask ExHarness whether the current tree would PASS.
constraints: MCP tools are verify and status only; there is no promote, accept, merge or credential tool.
Outer supervision remains the authority path; the MCP server is opt-in per run and never writes user CLI configuration.
agent-tools currently has zero runtime npm dependencies; adding @modelcontextprotocol/server requires a recorded comparison against a zero-dependency stdio implementation.
Sandbox, hooks that mutate ~/.codex or ~/.gemini, and replacing outer supervision are out of scope.
Research only in this lane: no product source edits, no self-issued readiness or fabricated Jev judgment.
Every input is labeled DELIVERED_TRUTH, PLANNED_CONTRACT or RESEARCH_DESIRED_STATE; planned contracts are never described as delivered.
successCriteria: Specify a stdio MCP server that exposes exharness_verify (run declared command verifiers at the current worktree HEAD) and exharness_status (attempt index, last verification, candidate sha) with typed JSON results.
Specify that promote, ACCEPT and lineage mutation cannot be invoked through MCP, and that a planted promote tool name is rejected.
Specify opt-in wiring so a supervised run can launch the server for that worktree only, without writing Codex/Kiro/agy user config, and that a run without the option never listens.
Specify Living docs stating MCP is a transport for verification queries, not acceptance authority, plus an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.
Ground the design in the executed productization probe, the BB-097 CLI MCP surfaces and the MCP TypeScript SDK eligibility check.
